title: INSPECT FLOW CONTROL VALVE AND MEASURE SPRING / REPLACE UNION SEAT

content.description: Cross-section diagram of power steering flow control valve showing compressed air being applied to valve with spool movement indicated by arrow. Shows internal valve components and housing.

content.text: 5. INSPECT FLOW CONTROL VALVE AND MEASURE SPRING

items: (a) Check the flow control valve for wear or damage.
(b) Apply fluid to the valve and check that it falls smoothly into the valve hole by its own weight.
(c) Check the flow control valve for leakage.
• Close one of the holes and apply compressed air [4 or 5 kg/cm² (57 or 71 psi, 392 or 490 kPa)] into the opposite side.
• Confirm that air does not come out from the end hole.

content.text: If necessary, replace the valve with one stamped with the same letter on the rear housing.
If the spring is not within specification, replace the spring.

content.description: Illustration showing hands measuring a coil spring with a ruler/caliper. The spring is positioned horizontally and being measured for length.

Detailed illustration showing the removal of union seat using a screw extractor wrench. The diagram shows a cross-section view of the union seat installation location with the extraction tool positioned.

items: (a) Using a screw extractor wrench, remove the union seat.
(b) Install a new floating type union seat.

content.text: NOTE: Only floating type parts are available.
